extracted.name: Gobhi Manchurian
ingredient_lines: 2 medium sized cups corn flour (cake measure)
1/2 tsp red chilli powder or sauce
instruction_lines: Chop cauliflower in florets.boil for ten minutes in water along with salt.remove water afterwards.
Mix corn flour and all-purpose flour add salt black pepper powder.make slurry add florets.heat oil in Deep pan
Keep flame on medium to high.deep fry florets,fry capsicum also keep aside after cooling for ten minutes again fry florets in oil.it makes florets more crunchy.

Now heat deep pan add 2tbspoon oil add some coariander leaves.here you can add garlic chopped but making for kids so avoided.add tomato sauce, green chilli sauce mix well add red chilli powder,salt mix well add some water then prepare corn flour slurry add gradually along with water.when becomes sticky add florets mix well,add capsicum.switch off the flame.
Mix well and serve hot with sauce and garnish with chopped coriander leaves.didnt get green onion so used coariander.tastes yum do try this.
